title: Free DIY Concept to Character Pipeline
author: sleeper-2
selftext:
Claude made this explainer for the concept art -> character pipeline it just built me. I learned about doing this from this sub, so thought I'd share back in case anyone else is wondering about specifics. 

  
LMK if I'm doing something really dumb too please! Also, it seems like there are potentially better models than Trellis.2 but I didn't find a better one without an onerous license with respect to what you can do with the assets. My background is CS + web/startup engineering, not at all gamedev but having a lot of fun learning.
